description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade checks and procedures for the OpenWrt project targeting iMX-based boards. It defines functions to verify compatibility, perform upgrades, and copy configuration files for various hardware models.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Checks if the current board requires image metadata verification based on its name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Determines if a system image is suitable for the detected hardware board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process tailored to the current hardware, choosing the appropriate method.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files post-upgrade for specific boards.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps executed before performing the actual upgrade.
